[Story]
Mom finishes making dinner, comes to the dining room to eat with dad and son, sees two pairs of chopsticks on the table, and says, "Strange, how many of us eat together today?"

[Question]
What does mom really mean when she says this?

[Candidate Answers]

B. Mom hints that there should be more people coming home.
